name: Potter Valley
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A Mendocino County valley AVA, near the Eel River watershed. The valley floor lies at about ⟦elev|920 to 1,020 feet|280 to 311 m⟧, ringed by mountains.
